title: The Demon Saint's farewell
summary: The remnant of the Pure Lotus Demon Saint, which entered Xiao Yan's body when he gathered the map fragments, uses it to fight the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame. He made the Refining Heaven Ancient Array himself and turns it against the flame, and everyone else flees the space before the flame erupts. Xun Er defies Gu Nanhai and the Gu Clan's rules and goes back to stay with Xiao Yan. The Demon Saint says he gave the flame its mind long ago and sealed it to calm its violence, then severs its memories and mind and vanishes with it as it begs for mercy. The Demon Flame's origin is left pure as a newborn, and with the space closed, Xiao Yan decides to refine it there with Xun Er. Outside, Zi Yan tells Gu Nanhai that the Dragon Seal is calm, so Xiao Yan must be alive. Inside a Flamefrost Grand Array, Xiao Yan refines the flame with the Flame Mantra and nearly dies until Xun Er joins in to help.
events: The Pure Lotus Demon Saint fights the Demon Flame in Xiao Yan's body.
Everyone flees the Demon Flame space.
Xun Er leaves Gu Nanhai and goes back to Xiao Yan.
The Demon Saint erases the flame's mind and vanishes with it.
Xiao Yan decides to refine the pure Demon Flame origin inside the closed space.
Outside, the Gu Clan and the Hall of Souls count their losses; Zi Yan sends Gu Nanhai home.
Xiao Yan refines the flame inside the Flamefrost Grand Array with the Flame Mantra.
Xun Er joins in to help him refine it.
